summary: The Black Crucible lies at the heart of the Corruption Core. Discord energy is refined, weaponized, and infused into Muramite war‑technology. The Crucible is the ultimate corruption engine, guarded by War‑Shades and corruption‑born entities.
history: Discord energy condensed into raw corruption pools.
Muramite engineers built the first Blight Furnaces.
Corruption‑born entities emerged from the Warrens.
Essence Pits expanded, spreading planar contamination.
The Black Crucible was forged as the ultimate corruption engine.
